# PROTOTYPE

> PROTOTYPE is an independent digital studio that builds modern, responsive business websites, landing pages and custom React frontends, from idea to interface.

## Services

- [Business Websites](https://prototype-f42.pages.dev/services/business-websites): Responsive, high-performance websites for growing businesses.
- [Landing Pages](https://prototype-f42.pages.dev/services/landing-pages): Focused single-page experiences built to convert visitors into leads.
- [Custom Frontend Development](https://prototype-f42.pages.dev/services/frontend-development): React and Vite web applications and dashboards.

## Pricing

- [Packages](https://prototype-f42.pages.dev/pricing): Three fixed-scope tiers (Liftoff, Orbit, Deep Space) with delivery timelines.

## Work

- [PCP Media](https://prototype-f42.pages.dev/projects/pcp-media): Digital marketing agency website, live at pcpmedia.in.
- [The Landmark](https://prototype-f42.pages.dev/projects/landmark): Demo concept for fine dining and wellness.
- [Apex Academy](https://prototype-f42.pages.dev/projects/apex-academy): Demo concept for coaching institutes.
- [ABC Portal](https://prototype-f42.pages.dev/projects/abc-portal): Demo concept for a campus ERP dashboard.
